name: EPIC 249701676
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 7.5 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249701676 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.508371 (16th-84th percentiles 7.34264-7.755515), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,869 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.89 solar masses and 7.5 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,631 K at its surface.
